universal_truths.observation: Legacy cloud resources not properly decommissioned create persistent attack vectors
evidence: Checkout.com breach via 5-year-old legacy cloud storage (Nov 2025)
ShinyHunters criminal group gained access to orphaned third-party system
High HN engagement (425-596 points) signals industry-wide concern
Less than 25% of merchants affected, but reputational damage significant
universal_truths.root_cause: System sprawl, no decommissioning process, orphaned credentials, data persistence
universal_truths.applicability_to_chained: High - Chained uses multiple GCP services over time (Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Firestore, Cloud SQL)
universal_truths.recommendation: Implement quarterly resource audit and formal decommissioning process

universal_truths.observation: 95% of organizations leave 20% of endpoints undiscovered and unprotected
evidence: N-able Convergence Blueprint highlights ITOps/SecOps silos
Vaguely defined areas of responsibility lead to gaps
universal_truths.root_cause: Organizational silos between IT operations and security operations teams
universal_truths.applicability_to_chained: Medium - Chained has error-observer but no security-observer
universal_truths.recommendation: Extend error-observer pattern to security events (Security-as-A2A-messages)
universal_truths.effort: Medium (1-2 weeks to implement security-observer service)

patterns.observation: Error Observer pattern extends naturally to security events
patterns.approach: Treat security anomalies as first-class A2A messages, create GitHub issues, assign to security agents
benefits: Integrates security into existing agent workflow
Security events become visible and actionable
implementation_steps: Integrate with A2A error handling pipeline

patterns.observation: Cloud resources require formal lifecycle management to prevent security debt
phases: Create (with tags: environment, owner, created_date, review_date, auto_delete)
patterns.anti_pattern: Create → Use → Migrate → [System still active] → Breach years later
patterns.best_practice: Quarterly resource audit with decommissioning checklist
automation_opportunities: Auto-delete resources tagged 'auto_delete: true' after 30 days idle
Alert on resources without required tags
patterns.applicability_to_chained: High - Prevents Checkout.com-style legacy system breaches

key_learnings.learning: Legacy cloud systems are security time bombs
key_learnings.context: Checkout.com breach occurred 5+ years after system was 'deprecated'
key_learnings.lesson: Deprecated ≠ Decommissioned. Formal deletion process required.
key_learnings.prevention: Quarterly audits + decommissioning checklist + automated cleanup

key_learnings.learning: Security observability gap is organizational, not technical
key_learnings.context: 95% of organizations have 20% endpoint coverage gaps
key_learnings.lesson: IT/Security silos create blind spots. Unified tooling solves this.

key_learnings.learning: Cloud security is infrastructure hygiene, not just app security
key_learnings.context: Checkout.com breach was infrastructure (legacy storage), not application code
key_learnings.lesson: Infrastructure security review must be routine process
key_learnings.implementation: Security reviews integrated into infrastructure-as-code workflow

key_learnings.context: Checkout.com publicly disclosed breach, took responsibility, donated to research
key_learnings.lesson: Transparency, accountability, and positive action turn breach into trust-building
key_learnings.chained_approach: If breach occurs: contain, investigate, notify, remediate, blameless post-mortem
